title: 声音的组织｜从聆听到实时演奏
titleEn: Organizing Sound — From Listening to Live Performance
summary: 从音乐史、艺术家与作品出发，走进声音制作、编排、混音与可演奏的现场。24章连续阅读，附背景知识地图与原创声音实验。
summaryEn: A 24-chapter reader tracing how sound becomes composition and how a finished piece opens into live performance, with an interactive historical atlas and original audio studies.
